author: ZXZRQ2
quote: GTA 6 has a few major downsides. It is limited to 30 FPS on consoles with no 60 FPS mode, the story can feel too long and padded, and some missions become repetitive. Jason and Lucia are not always the focus of their own story, while some side characters can feel annoying or one-dimensional. The humor can also feel repetitive and immature at times. Combat is improved but not revolutionary, with some bullet-sponge enemies. The huge map can mean long travel times, and some realism features like eating, exercising, and refueling may feel more like chores. The UI and controls can occasionally be frustrating, and there are still some minor bugs and glitches. The expensive Ultimate Edition and the lack of a PC version at launch are also major drawbacks. Finally, the extremely high expectations surrounding GTA 6 make it difficult for the game to satisfy everyone.
